fixed.explanation: In online_ewma, the decay exponent is deltas[j - 1], which indexes by column j rather than by row i. The deltas array is per row, so for a single column the wrong element is used, or it is out of range. The decay is lost and the result is a plain cumulative mean. The fix is to index with the row, deltas[i - 1].

input.intent: Online/incremental exponentially weighted moving mean (EWM online, ExponentialMovingWindow.online, EWMMeanState) update path that, for single-column inputs, computes a plain cumulative mean and ignores the decay/alpha weights; should apply the same weighting as the regular ewm mean.
input.symptom: Online EWM mean for single-column DataFrames ignores decay and returns a plain cumulative mean instead of matching the regular ewm mean.
